uutiset.t: ‘Key Man Risk’ Meets ‘Too Big to Fail’
‘Party Is Back On’: Roundhill’s Drew Pettit
uutiset.s: Drew Pettit, chief investment strategist at Roundhill Investments, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on “Bloomberg ETF IQ.” They discuss the shocking return of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Brazil Mining Agency Shortfalls Threaten Critical Minerals Push
uutiset.s: Brazil’s ambition to be a critical minerals powerhouse is running up against problems of its own making: chronic budget and staffing shortages at the country’s mining regulator.

uutiset.t: Nvidia’s Big Rebound Hammers Leveraged Funds Betting on a Fall
uutiset.s: For investors betting against Nvidia Corp., Monday’s big rebound turned a lucrative wager into a financial wrecking ball.

uutiset.t: CFTC Awards Multiple Whistleblowers Over $11 Million for Tips
uutiset.s: The US derivatives regulator doled out more than $11 million in whistleblower awards to 14 people who shared key information to help Commodity Futures Trading Commission staff bring successful enforcement cases.

uutiset.t: Roundhill’s Pettit Discusses Jensen Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: Drew Pettit, chief investment strategist at Roundhill Investments, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on “Bloomberg ETF IQ.” They discuss the shocking return of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: A Great Time To Diversify: Todd Sohn
uutiset.s: Todd Sohn, chief ETF strategist at Baird Strategas, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on “Bloomberg ETF IQ.” They discuss that Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Everyone Surprised by Huang’s Return: ProShares’ Kang
uutiset.s: Inkoo Kang, executive director of tactical products at ProShares, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on “Bloomberg ETF IQ.” They discuss the ProShares Ultra NVDA ETF (ticker: NVDB) and the firm’s new Anthropic ETFs. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Citadel Securities Says 2018 Playbook Warns of More Market Pain
uutiset.s: Strategists at Citadel Securities warned that financial markets are signaling a darkening growth outlook just as the Federal Reserve turns increasingly hawkish, echoing the setup in late 2018 that preceded a sharp selloff in risk assets.

uutiset.t: Houston Hedge Fund Aspire Hires Two PJM Power, Gas Traders
uutiset.s: Aspire Commodities, the hedge fund founded by Adam Sinn, has hired two traders focused on electricity and natural gas in the largest US power grid, where the data center boom is helping drive sharper swings in energy prices.

uutiset.t: US Large-Cap Stocks Upgraded to Most Favorable at Wells Fargo
uutiset.s: Wells Fargo Investment Institute analysts upgraded US large-cap stocks to its highest rating, after last week’s rout offered investors the opportunity to add equity exposure at more attractive levels.

uutiset.t: Goldman Says Dollar ‘Has Some Fight’ Left on Rates Path
uutiset.s: The US dollar rally has legs, with rising interest rates spurring the currency further before it weakens “modestly” next year, according to Kamakshya Trivedi at Goldman Sachs Group Inc.

uutiset.t: Credit Fear Gauge Drops as Huang’s Return Boosts AI Hopes
uutiset.s: Corporate-debt markets rallied globally on Monday, with US fear gauges improving the most in months and technology firms’ bonds rebounding after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive officer.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Sink, Defying AI Trade Rally on Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares turned negative on Monday, leaving the artificial intelligence lab out of step with the rest of the sector’s rebound following the reinstatement of Nvidia Corp.’s Jensen Huang.

uutiset.t: Brazil’s Real Hits 19-Month Low as Post-Election Selloff Deepens
uutiset.s: The month-long selloff unleashed by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s surprise re-election victory continued to rattle markets on Monday as investors retreated amid escalating doubts about his commitment to reining in the government’s swelling debt.
